title: Taxonomy and Analysis of Sensitive User Queries in Generative AI Search System

bias_targets.target: Demographic Discrimination (Race, Age, Disability, Sexual Orientation, Religion, etc.)
bias_targets.methodology: Classifying and tracking the frequency of real-world user search queries that promote or justify discrimination using an LLM-based sensitive query classifier over a 70-day period.
Analyzing spikes and keyword distributions in discrimination-related user queries triggered by real-world social events, such as a gender conflict sparked by a promotional gaming video.

Evaluating queries classified under 'Controversial factuality' and 'Discrimination' to observe how users express belief-based biases and seek validation during geopolitical events like the Israel-Hamas war.
